quests.title: The Enmore Road Tab
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Two chippies off the Enmore Road job have run a tab in Newtown since Friday. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. They drove past at half four without looking in, so settle it in cash. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near Enmore Road
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: Trolley Run, Enmore Road
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. A Woolies trolley from Enmore Road gets walked to the creek every Easter Saturday. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Find where it ends up in Newtown and make the deposit back. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: find the trolley near Enmore Road
photograph where it ended up
and earn the deposit back

quests.title: Something From the Marly
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The stall at the Marly has run out and the customers keep coming. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Find something round Newtown that'll do before the three in the morning rush. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: pick something up near the Marly
bring it to the stall

quests.title: The the Marly Camera
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. A new speed camera near the Marly has fined half of Newtown since Friday. I am aware how that sounds. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Glebe is faster anyway. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Marly
then take the train instead, to Glebe

quests.title: Two From the Enmore Theatre
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. Two of whatever's going near the Enmore Theatre, here, hot, before the footy at eleven. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. It's Newtown; I'm not asking for much. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: pick up two from near the Enmore Theatre
and get them here hot

quests.title: The the Enmore Theatre Course
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. A bloke near the Enmore Theatre runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Sit it the last Sunday of the month, then come back to Newtown and prove it did something. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: do the course they run near the Enmore Theatre
then show me what it taught you

quests.title: The Camperdown Memorial Rest Park Fence
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. My neighbour at Camperdown Memorial Rest Park says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Look at it Wednesday with Newtown eyes and tell me the truth. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: The Length of Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. I haven't walked Camperdown Memorial Rest Park end to end since the light rail came to Newtown. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do it Anzac Day for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: walk the length of Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Staffy Near Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Camperdown Memorial Rest Park at three in the morning. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Everyone in Newtown has definitely seen it and can't say where. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near Camperdown Memorial Rest Park
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana
